blocks.title: NeuralDB
blocks.subtitle: The database that writes its own queries.
blocks.description: AI-native database engine. Describe what you need in plain English. Get optimized queries in milliseconds.

items.title: Natural Language Queries
items.description: Write queries in plain English. NeuralDB understands intent, resolves ambiguity, and generates optimized SQL under the hood — no query language to learn.

items.title: Auto-Indexing
items.description: NeuralDB monitors query patterns in real time and creates, adjusts, or drops indexes automatically. Your database tunes itself while you sleep.

items.title: Real-time Analytics
items.description: Stream aggregations, window functions, and materialized views that update in milliseconds. No ETL pipeline, no warehouse — analytics at the source.

items.title: Self-Healing
items.description: Automatic failover, corruption detection, and schema drift repair. NeuralDB predicts hardware failures before they happen and migrates data proactively.
